SELECT 
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p."gender" = 'F' THEN p."patient" END)::numeric 
     / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m."patient")::numeric, 0)) * 100 AS "female_percentage"
FROM "medications" m
JOIN "patients" p ON m."patient" = p."patient"
WHERE m."description" = 'Penicillin V Potassium 250 MG'

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN total = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE (female::numeric / total) * 100
  END AS "female_percentage"
FROM (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT p."patient") FILTER (WHERE p."gender" = 'F') AS female,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p."patient") AS total
  FROM "medications" m
  JOIN "patients" p ON m."patient" = p."patient"
  WHERE m."description" = 'Penicillin V Potassium 250 MG'
) sub

WITH med_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT "patient"
  FROM "medications"
  WHERE "description" = 'Penicillin V Potassium 250 MG'
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
       ELSE (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p."gender" = 'F')::numeric / COUNT(*)::numeric) * 100
  END AS "female_percentage"
FROM med_patients mp
JOIN "patients" p ON p."patient" = mp."patient"
